name: Majokko★roid Kururu-chan
original_name: 魔女ッ娘★ロイド クルルちゃん
source:
This story is set in a happy, yet embarrassing near future...

Cars running through tubes and a much closer moon are just a sign of the times. 

Of course even in the future the main job of a student is to study, and that’s where we are now. Our good ol’ St. Maria Academy is having its student counsel elections for its senior class in accordance with its unimpeachable, unsurpassable, totally peaceful school rules. Instead of going to class, candidates spend their hellish days in fierce debates. A plane with candidates on it hovers over the school, trying to buy votes with meal tickets for the school cafeteria. 

Meanwhile strange rumors surround the captain of the “Muppet Club” Iseya Cordelia, considered a strong candidate for the next student council president. 

Minor organizations, like the Transforming Robot Lovers Association, the Sentai Hero Research Club, or the Space War Ship Club might risk death scrambling for votes to get even a sniff of the power of the Muppet Club. It’s the largest group in the school and, jeez louise, at this point the Muppet Club might even hold sway over the whole nation’s Muppet industry! 

[Translation of synopsis from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=244]Getchu.com[/url]]
translation:
这个故事发生在一个快乐而又尴尬的不久的将来……

汽车穿过管道和更近的月亮只是时代的标志。

当然，将来学生的主要工作还是学习，我们现在就是这样。我们善良的圣玛丽亚学院正在按照其无懈可击、无与伦比、完全和平的校规进行高年级学生顾问选举。候选人们没有去上课，而是在激烈的辩论中度过了地狱般的日子。一架载有候选人的飞机盘旋在学校上空，试图用学校食堂的餐票购买选票。

与此同时，“布偶俱乐部”队长伊塞亚·科迪莉亚周围流传着奇怪的谣言，她被认为是下届学生会主席的有力候选人。

诸如变形机器人爱好者协会、战队英雄研究俱乐部或太空战舰俱乐部之类的小型组织可能会冒着死亡的危险争夺选票，以求尝尝布偶俱乐部的力量。这是学校里最大的团体，天哪，现在布偶俱乐部甚至可能会掌控整个国家的布偶产业！
